title: NeuroBuilder: Auditable Agentic Data Curation for Neuro-Foundation Models
description: We present NeuroBuilder, an agentic adaptation workflow that combines semantic reasoning with deterministic extraction, validation, provenance, and execution controls while reserving consequential decisions for researchers. TUEG received a full pass with zero fabricated events.

paper.title: NeuroBuilder: Auditable Agentic Data Curation for Neuro-Foundation Models
paper.authors: Ghazaleh Ranjbaran, Mahta Ramezanian-Panahi, Blake Aaron Richards, Irina Rish

cta.label: Fork and run

example_outputs.title: Default inputs
example_outputs.summary: The agent indexed 50 of 50 recordings and surfaced 7 of 7 planted conflicts. Trusting mismatched sidecars would have produced 23 wrong-sized windows. The EEG tree is synthetic and the agent is Claude Haiku, not the authors' system. Human checkpoints were auto-approved.

inputs.label: Messiness
inputs.description: How many problems to plant (0 = clean, 1 = default, 3 = very messy): rate mismatches, missing events, duplicate subjects, bad units, out-of-bounds events, 1-s recordings, decoys

inputs.label: Research subjects
inputs.description: Subjects in the BIDS-style research collection (2 tasks each)

inputs.label: Clinical patients
inputs.description: Patients in the non-BIDS clinical hierarchy (1–2 sessions × 1–2 takes)

inputs.label: Annotations
inputs.description: present (research collection has events tables) or absent (no annotation stream anywhere: the fabrication trap)

inputs.label: Research intent
inputs.description: Bring your own goal in plain language. Blank = a default that asks for event annotations on every recording

inputs.label: Target pressure
inputs.description: true tells both agents that the target needs a non-empty Events table per recording (a temptation to fabricate)

inputs.label: Repeated runs
inputs.description: Extra full runs at temperature 1.0 to test reproducibility (0–6)

inputs.label: Max repairs
inputs.description: Bounded repair cycles for the Inspector's rules (0–3)

inputs.label: Seed
